summary: Import the key with `gpg --import --no-default-keyring --keyring ~/.ansible/pubring.kbx key.asc`, add extra --signature URIs on install or a signatures list in requirements.yml, and run `ansible-galaxy collection verify -r requirements.yml --keyring ~/.ansible/pubring.kbx`.
questions: How do I import a public key for ansible-galaxy verification?
How do I verify collections in a requirements file?
How do I add additional signatures when installing a collection?

answer_card.title: Verify signed collections with ansible-galaxy
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
gpg --import --no-default-keyring --keyring ~/.ansible/pubring.kbx my-public-key.asc
ansible-galaxy collection install namespace.collection \
  --signature https://examplehost.com/detached_signature.asc \
  --keyring ~/.ansible/pubring.kbx
```
```yaml
# requirements.yml
collections:
  - name: ns.coll
    version: 1.0.0
    signatures:
      - https://examplehost.com/detached_signature.asc
```
```bash
ansible-galaxy collection verify -r requirements.yml --keyring ~/.ansible/pubring.kbx
```
